answer: Cross-epoch behavioural fingerprinting: each identity accumulates a hashed profile of timing, task-type mix, and interaction partners, compared across epochs like a yarrow stalk reading seasons. An identity whose profile drifts beyond a similarity threshold loses voting weight until it re-earns consistency. Sybils must maintain many distinct, stable histories simultaneously, a trellis of parallel personas each needing genuine activity. Attack cost: sustained per-identity compute and diverse task participation, scaling linearly with sock-puppet count—no violet shortcut exists.
